facts.business: Wendt (India) Limited is a total grinding solution provider offering Super Abrasives Tooling, Grinding & Honing Machines, and Precision Components to automobile, auto component, engineering, aerospace, defence, and ceramics industries.

key_risks: Global macroeconomic conditions including commodity price volatility, external demand conditions, and capital flow movements
Geopolitical developments and financial market volatility
Currency volatility due to Middle East conflict and capital flow dynamics
External dependencies in energy imports influencing inflation and currency movements
Cyclical demand from auto and aerospace industries
High entry barriers due to complexity of Super Abrasives technology and high initial investment
facts.related_party_note: During FY 2024-25, the Promoters at that point in time, Carborundum Universal Limited (CUMI) and Wendt GmbH (now PG&F Super Abrasives GmbH), amended the Shareholders' Agreement (SHA) on 21st January 2025 to facilitate a potential divestment by Wendt GmbH. On 14th May 2025, Wendt GmbH was informed that the divestment would be undertaken through an Offer for Sale (OFS). Wendt GmbH divested its entire 37.5% shareholding (7,50,000 equity shares) through the OFS on 15th and 16th May 2025. Post the divestment, Wendt GmbH ceased to be a shareholder and subsequently reclassified to Public category from the Promoter category with effect from 22nd September 2025. The Company was not a party to such agreement and there is no liability to the Company under this agreement.
